study: ordered landmark witnesses on frozen single-frame grounding
causal_panel: From previously evaluated ordinary validation only. Full annotated visible inventory. Same scene, noun and side. Only landmark noun or depth extremum varies. Four distinct annotated endpoints. Use immediate neighbor by signed horizontal projected center, demand projected separation >0.015 image widths from anchor and uniqueness margin >0.015 versus nearest rival. Depth extremes must have disjoint optical-depth intervals and identical extremum by Euclidean camera distance. Up to 48 new physical frames per platform and family; hash-order recording round robin. Deduplicate scans by content across families and against prior 483 scans. No model scores for selection.
natural: Same 168 prior natural and 576 ordinary records retained in separate groups; original captions and v1 replay verified. Both target-source directions kept.
main: Union of score-level sets. First semantic witness ordered by optical depth for stated superlatives and horizontal relation for explicit immediate subjects. Otherwise categorical noun mass and bare half-plane. Conditional shape is the weighted median of three anchored occupancy cross sections of subject-only and full-sentence boxes. Physical association by box density affinity, no learned weights.
controls: Same frozen full, subject and landmark views, original point sampling, PCA, data, geometric summaries and budgets. Single cut at 0.5 for explicit order. Misbound cyclically shifts physical reference confidence in horizontal order. Opposite caption only in post-seal paired evaluation.
metrics: Both target identities right for the two paired expressions; all four endpoints right; official >.25 and >.50, rescue/harm, six directions and recording-cluster bootstrap. Natural endpoint identity independently annotated where available. New positive shapes must exceed all actually generated axis and PCA boxes and retain correct physical ownership.
supervision: Annotations for construction and subsequent scoring only, no model fitting or target parameter selection. This is a separate, deliberately compositional diagnostic, not an official caption/annotation change or blind benchmark.
